claim_boundary: RED fixture/story-test seed only; no runtime, no UI readiness, no production, no GA, no customer-availability claim, no handler/storage/deployment/live-SLO/customer-visible rollout, and no generated JSON hand edit.

notes: PR #1145 is API/contract-only and links OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, and proto replay fixtures.
PR #1145 records browser/live UI/WCAG evidence as explicit no-UI N/A, not as UI readiness.
API/contract-only replay remains supporting evidence for this future user-story seed.

runtime_evidence_policy: No UI exists in this lane; the fixture remains fail-closed and records explicit N/A for live/browser execution until a future UI shell or story replay exists.
A future UI/story Build must add browser and Playwright evidence for employee, personal user, manager/approver, compliance officer, and scheduler-integrator paths before closing this RED status.
Green CI alone is insufficient for user-facing calendar readiness; API/contract replay evidence from PR #1145 cannot be promoted into browser/live UI evidence.
accessibility_i18n_responsive_checklist: WCAG 2.2 AA keyboard traversal across create/update event form, context switch, approval card, legal-hold verification, policy-denied dialog, and replay/error states.
Deterministic focus order, visible focus, escape/enter behavior, and no keyboard trap for modal, drawer, date/time, attendee, resource, action-card, and legal-hold affordances.

Screen-reader labels and descriptions for work/personal context, retention/legal-hold disclosure, policy basis, free/busy projection, 403 denial, audit link, Workflow handoff, loading, and error states.
Responsive coverage for mobile-portrait, mobile-landscape, tablet, desktop, and wide-desktop without hiding policy/audit/legal-hold context.
Loading, empty, policy-denied, validation-error, legal-hold-conflict, offline/sync, and retry states are visible and audit-safe.
KR and en-US i18n strings exist for form labels, actions, denial reasons, policy-basis disclosure, retention/legal-hold context, Workflow handoff, and accessibility announcements.
Green CI alone is insufficient; browser/user-story/accessibility evidence or explicit no-UI N/A must be recorded per slice.

must_assert: AC-01 work event create path is Org pillar, tenant-DEK backed, retention-classed, and audit logged.
AC-01 work event update path preserves attendee accept/change audit history.
AC-05 selected KR/EU/US retention window and legal hold context remain visible before save.
Employee sees visible audit, retention, legal hold, attendee/resource, validation, loading, error, and policy-denied context before and after create/update.
must_reject: Runtime handler or storage implementation in this RED seed.
Production-ready UI or customer-visible calendar readiness claim from this fixture.
Green CI alone used as browser/user-story evidence.

must_assert: AC-02 personal event details remain hidden while work scheduling sees minimum necessary disclosure.
Org/admin/scheduler sees only allowed free/busy projection or a 403 denial.
Free/busy projection expiry, recipient scope, policy denial reason, and audit-safe explanation are visible without exposing details.
must_reject: Personal title visible to org admin or scheduler.
Personal description visible to org admin or scheduler.
Personal location visible to org admin or scheduler.
Personal attendees visible to org admin or scheduler.
Silent personal availability mining.

must_assert: AC-03 approval is explicit action card interaction, not implicit Workflow inference.
policy_basis, Workflow handoff target, consent/policy disclosure, and audit_ref are visible before approval.
Workflow receives policy-gated handoff and the story links event, action, consent/policy basis, and WorkflowHandoffAuditLog.
must_reject: Implicit Workflow inference from calendar details.
Workflow handoff without policy_basis.
Workflow handoff without audit_ref.

must_assert: AC-04 legal hold preserves event, attendee history, action cards, and audit chain through retention expiry.
Compliance officer can verify legal hold scope, chain-of-custody, retention expiry override, action-card preservation, and audit export state.
Chain-of-custody evidence remains visible without leaking unrelated personal event detail.
must_reject: Purge while legal hold is active.
Hard delete of attendee history, action cards, or audit chain under hold.
Chain-of-custody gap hidden by a green status.

must_assert: WCAG 2.2 AA checks cover keyboard traversal, visible focus, focus order, screen-reader labels, contrast, reduced motion, and audit-safe announcements.
Responsive behavior preserves policy, audit, retention, free/busy, action-card, and legal-hold context across mobile-portrait, mobile-landscape, tablet, desktop, and wide-desktop.
Loading, validation error, policy-denied, legal-hold conflict, offline/sync, and retry states are represented.
KR and en-US labels, help text, denial messages, and screen-reader announcements are captured.
must_reject: Green CI alone used to close user-facing readiness.
Keyboard traversal missing from the CRUD story.
Screen-reader labels missing from policy, audit, retention, denial, or legal-hold states.

must_assert: PR #1145 supplies existing OpenAPI replay evidence for API/contract-only calendar semantics.
PR #1145 supplies existing AsyncAPI replay evidence for calendar event, availability projection, action card, and workflow handoff families.
PR #1145 supplies existing proto replay evidence for structural personal/work separation.
PR #1145 records explicit no-UI N/A for browser/live UI/accessibility evidence because it was API/contract-only.
must_reject: Browser evidence from API-only PR #1145 replay.
UI readiness inferred from OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, or proto replay.
Customer availability or rollout claim from contract-only evidence.
